title: Polyurethane Insulation
description: Thermal conductivity (k-values) calculator for polyurethane insulation versus temperature. Polyurethane is an organic polymer used in flexible foams, coatings, adhesives, sealants, and insulation applications for buildings and technical systems.

components.content: Enter the temperature and select the desired unit system to calculate thermal conductivity conversions for polyurethane insulation. Use the conversion factor to switch between metric and imperial units.

## Temperature Conversion Formula

- **Celsius to Fahrenheit**: T (°F) = 9/5 × T (°C) + 32
- **Fahrenheit to Celsius**: T (°C) = 5/9 × (T (°F) - 32)

## Thermal Conductivity Conversion

- **1 W/(m·K) = 6.935 Btu·in/(h·ft²·°F)**

## Applications

Polyurethane insulation is commonly used in:
- Building insulation systems
- Heat exchangers
- Cooling pipes
- Flexible foams and mattresses
- Chemical-resistant coatings
- Adhesives and sealants
